'''Trade Federation Center''' was an area of the [[Karthakk system]] under control of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Trade Federation set up a research center in the outer reaches of this [[Star system/Legends|system]]. It was there hope to collect segments of the [[Spine of Lok]], studying the [[Obsidian/Legends|obsidian]] [[Mineral/Legends|rocks]] to provide information to various allies about possible sales and alliances. However, several [[Spy/Legends|spies]] discovered that the Trade Federation had been conducting these secret experiments away from the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and other potential enemies.<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trade Federation Center was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
